item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00980","case1_error":"Adds 12 to depth when “12 feet higher” requires subtracting 12.","case2_error":"Uses one-third instead of two-thirds for Gerry, then misassigns raft totals and double-counts Micky’s sticks.","reason":"The first reverses a directional relation; the second drops a fraction’s numerator and incorrectly combines quantities.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00981","case1_error":"Correctly writes 36 × 9 × 12 but incorrectly replaces 36 × 9 with 432.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final earnings of 6351 after a correct formula; the formula yields 6318.","reason":"The first shows a specific numerical evaluation error; the second supplies an incorrect final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00982","case1_error":"Treats the 70% discount as the amount paid instead of subtracting it from the original price.","case2_error":"Treats the 10% discount as the boots’ purchase price instead of subtracting it from the original price.","reason":"Both confuse the discount amount with the remaining price.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00983","case1_error":"Omits the mandatory $20 flat fee from the total deposit.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final savings of 34 after correctly specifying savings minus spending; the result should be 40.","reason":"The first omits a required component from its formula; the second gives an incorrect final number after a correct formula.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00984","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final numbers after a correct deposit formula, which yields $1110.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final total of 108 after a correct formula, which yields 156 students.","reason":"Both append incorrect numerical answers to correct formulas without showing calculations that explain those numbers.","judgment":"same"}]}
